concepts.name: Demographic Dividend
concepts.description: The economic growth opportunity arising from a larger working-age population relative to dependents, which requires strategic investment in education and employment to maximize potential.

frameworks.name: Sustainable Development Framework
frameworks.description: A framework that integrates economic growth, social equity, and environmental sustainability to ensure long-term prosperity without compromising future generations.

principles.name: Inclusive Growth
principles.description: Growth that benefits all segments of society, ensuring that economic opportunities are accessible and equitable across different demographics and regions.

principles.name: Demographic Transition
principles.description: The shift from a young to an older population structure, which requires strategic planning to leverage the demographic dividend and avoid economic stagnation.
